learning_objectives: Check out a book to a patron.
prerequisites: Basic computer literacy and familiarity with common library terms.

slides.title: Welcome
slides.narration:
Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial.
Today we will explore key features in Koha.
Koha is an Integrated Library System.
slides.image_prompt: Title slide: 'Exploring Features in Koha' with Koha logo and library imagery.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
content: Check out a book to a patron.
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to:
Navigate the Koha staff interface.
Add a new patron record.
Perform a basic catalog search.
Check out a book to a patron.
And generate a simple report.
slides.image_prompt: Standard learning objectives slide with bullet points.

slides.title: System Requirements
content: Access to a Koha staff client.
slides.narration:
To follow this tutorial, you need:
A computer with internet access.
A web browser like Firefox or Chrome.
And access to a Koha staff client.
We will use Koha version 22.05.
slides.image_prompt: Icons representing computer, internet, browser, and Koha logo.

slides.title: Prerequisites
content: Understanding of an Integrated Library System (ILS).
slides.narration:
Before starting, you should know:
Basic computer operations.
Common library terms.
And what an Integrated Library System is.
slides.image_prompt: Icons representing basic computer knowledge and library books.

slides.title: Koha Staff Interface
slides.narration:
Let's start by logging into Koha.
Open your web browser.
Go to your Koha staff client URL.
Enter your username and password.
Click on the Login button.
You will see the main dashboard.
This is your staff interface.
It has menus for different modules.
Think of it as your library's control panel.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of Koha staff login page, then main dashboard with modules like 'Patrons', 'Circulation', 'Cataloging' highlighted.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of logging into Koha and showing the dashboard.

slides.title: Add a New Patron
slides.narration:
Now, let's add a new patron.
Look for the Patrons module.
Click on Patrons.
Then, click on New Patron.
A list of patron categories appears.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of Koha staff dashboard, mouse cursor hovering over 'Patrons' menu, then clicking 'New Patron'.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of navigating to 'New Patron' via the 'Patrons' module.

slides.title: Select Patron Category
slides.narration:
Select a category for the new patron.
For example, choose 'Adult'.
This opens the patron registration form.
This form collects all necessary patron details.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot showing patron categories, with 'Adult' highlighted and selected.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of selecting 'Adult' from patron categories.

slides.title: Fill Patron Details
content: Enter required information: First Name, Last Name, Cardnumber.
slides.narration:
Fill in the required details.
Enter the patron's First Name.
Enter their Last Name.
Add a unique Cardnumber.
Scroll down to the bottom.
Click on the Save button.
You have successfully added a new patron.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of Koha patron registration form, fields like 'First Name', 'Last Name', 'Cardnumber' filled, and 'Save' button highlighted.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of filling out the patron registration form and saving.

slides.title: Search the Catalog
content: Search by title, author, or keyword.
slides.narration:
Next, let's search for a book.
Go to the top search bar.
This is the Quick Search.
You can search by title, author, or keyword.
It helps you find items quickly.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of Koha staff interface, pointing to the main search bar at the top.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording showing the quick search bar.

slides.title: Perform a Search
slides.narration:
Type your search term.
For example, type 'Koha'.
Click on the Search button.
The search results will display.
You can then view details of each item.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of Koha search bar with 'Koha' typed in, and search button clicked, showing results page.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of typing 'Koha' into the search bar and viewing results.

slides.title: Check Out a Book
content: Enter patron's Cardnumber or Last Name.
slides.narration:
Now, let's check out a book.
Click on the Circulation module.
Find the 'Check out' tab.
Enter the patron's Cardnumber or Last Name.
Click on the Submit button.
The patron's details will appear.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of Koha Circulation module, 'Check out' tab active, with patron search field filled and 'Submit' button highlighted.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of navigating to Circulation and entering patron details for checkout.

slides.title: Scan Item
slides.narration:
Enter the book's barcode.
You can type it or scan it.
The system will process the checkout.
The book is now issued to the patron.
This completes the circulation process.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of Koha checkout screen, with item barcode input field highlighted, and a book successfully checked out.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of entering a book's barcode and completing the checkout.

slides.title: Generate a Report
slides.narration:
Finally, let's generate a simple report.
Click on the Reports module.
This gives you various reporting options.
Reports help analyze library data.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of Koha staff interface, mouse cursor hovering over 'Reports' menu, then clicking on it.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of navigating to the 'Reports' module.

slides.title: Run a Basic Report
content: Choose a predefined report (e.g., 'Circulation by branch').
Run the report and view data.
slides.narration:
Choose a predefined report.
For example, select 'Circulation by branch'.
Click on the 'Run' button.
The report data will display.
You can export this data if needed.
This helps track library activity.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of Koha Reports module, showing a list of reports, with 'Circulation by branch' selected and 'Run' button highlighted.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of selecting and running a basic report in Koha.

slides.title: Summary
content: Checked out a book to a patron.
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, we learned to:
Navigate the Koha staff interface.
Add a new patron record.
Perform a basic catalog search.
Check out a book to a patron.
And generate a simple report.
These are essential Koha skills.
slides.image_prompt: Summary slide with bullet points of learned objectives.

slides.title: Assignment
content: Add another patron with different details.
Search for a book by its author.
Check in the book you checked out earlier.
slides.narration:
Here is a small assignment for you.
Add another patron with different details.
Search for a book by its author.
Check in the book you checked out earlier.
Explore other predefined reports.
Practice these steps in Koha.
slides.image_prompt: Assignment slide with bullet points for practice tasks.
